summary: Truncated strftime padding modifiers (%_, %-, and %0) cause an out-of-bounds panic because the tokenizer accesses self.input[2] without checking its existence. The fix uses get(2) and returns InvalidFormatDescription::Expected for a valid escape sequence at byte index 2. The fix adds the selected regression test; case_1 covers %_. The integration tests require --all-features. This is a plan only; no tests were run.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 2 but the index is 2
